Metadata.title: Parkfairy
Metadata.description: Find and book parking ahead of time.

Home.title: Parking, booked before you arrive.
Home.lead: Reserve a spot at garages and private spaces near where you are going, with the full price shown up front.
Home.featuredLead: Garages and private spaces you can compare right now.

search.title: Search
search.text: Pick an area or use your location, then choose when you arrive and when you leave.

compare.title: Compare
compare.text: See opening hours, free spaces and the full price for your stay before you go.

park.title: Park
park.text: Head to your named space. Online booking is coming soon.

Home.accountText: Create a free account to be ready when online booking opens.
Home.ownerHeading: Have a parking space you don’t always use?
Home.ownerText: List it on Parkfairy and earn from it. It takes a few steps, and you can stop and carry on whenever you like.

landing.title: Earn from the parking you already have
landing.lead: List a garage, a yard or a single space. Drivers find it, and you stay in charge of prices and opening hours.

need.details: Your name or your company’s, an address and a phone number
need.tax: Your tax number and, for companies, the registration number
need.proof: A document showing you may rent out this parking: a deed, a lease or a licence

steps.about: Tell us about yourself (you only do this once)
steps.place: Describe your parking: where it is, its spaces and its hours
steps.prices: Set your prices and cancellation policy
steps.review: Add photos and proof, then send it to us to check

landing.saveNote: Everything saves as you go, so you can stop and carry on whenever suits you.

dashboard.title: Your parking
dashboard.lead: Everything you’ve entered is saved. Carry on from where you stopped.

stepLeads.profile: Who drivers’ payments go to. Drivers don’t see this.

stepLeads.location: Where your parking is, and how to describe it to drivers.
stepLeads.spaces: Every space has its own name, so a driver knows exactly where to park.
stepLeads.hours: When drivers can come and go. A stay must fall within these hours.
stepLeads.prices: What a stay costs, and what happens if a driver cancels.
stepLeads.photos: Good photos help drivers recognise the entrance and trust the listing.
stepLeads.proof: We need to see that you may rent out this parking. Drivers never see this document.

closures.lead: Days when your parking is closed, or open at other times than usual. On those days, from midnight to midnight, what you set here replaces your weekly hours, unless you close only part of the day.

bookings.title: Bookings
bookings.lead: Confirmed bookings that haven’t ended yet, soonest first.

earnings.unavailable: Your earnings can’t be shown right now. Please try again in a moment.

empty.cancelled: No cancelled bookings in these days.

by.owner: The listing’s team or our support

bookingList.windowProblem: There is a problem with the days
bookingList.windowOrder: The last day is before the first day. Choose a last day on or after the first.
bookingList.windowSpan: The days are more than a year apart. Choose days at most a year apart.

overstay.hint: Was a car left in a space after its stay ended? Use “Report an overstay” on that booking, within {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} of the stay’s end.
overstay.lead: Was a car still in the space after this booking ended? Tell us and our team will look into it. The driver isn’t told, and nothing is charged or refunded because of this report.
overstay.noteHint: Which car, how long it stayed on, and anything you did. Our team reads this; the driver doesn’t. Up to {max, number} characters.
overstay.sent: Report sent. Our team will look into it.
overstay.reported: An overstay was reported on {date}. Our team will look into it.
overstay.closed: An overstay was reported on {date}. Our team has looked into it and closed the report.

payouts.title: Getting paid
payouts.lead: Drivers pay when they book. 24 hours after each stay ends, we send your share to Stripe, our payment provider, which pays it into your bank account on its usual schedule.

status.none: You haven’t set up payouts yet. Drivers can book your parking once you have, and once it’s live.
status.restricted: Stripe can’t pay you at the moment. Until it can, drivers can’t book your parking, and any payouts due to you wait. Continue with Stripe to see what it needs.
status.pending: Stripe is checking your details. This usually takes a few minutes, sometimes a day or two. Until then, drivers can’t book your parking and payouts wait.
status.active: Payouts are set up. Drivers can book your parking once it’s live.

payouts.expired: That link to Stripe has expired.

owners.title: Owners
owners.lead: Everyone listed here has full control of this listing: edit it, set its hours and prices, see and cancel its bookings, and invite others. Only the primary owner can remove owners, set the shares or delete the listing.
owners.sharesLead: Each stay’s payout is split by these shares. Drivers can book only while every owner with a share has set up payouts with Stripe.
owners.notPayable: Drivers can’t book this listing until every owner with a share has set up payouts.
owners.removeQuestion: Remove <person>{name}</person> from this listing’s owners? Their share goes back to you.
owners.leaveQuestion: Leave this listing? You won’t have access to it any more, and your share goes back to the primary owner.
owners.inviteLead: We’ll email a link that works for {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}. It is accepted by signing in, or creating an account, with that address.
owners.room: {count, plural, =0 {This listing already has the most owners and invitations allowed ({max}).} one {You can add # more owner or invitation.} other {You can add # more owners or invitations.}}
owners.sharesHint: Whole percentages; together they must add up to 100%.
owners.shareNeedsDetails: <person>{name}</person> can have a share once they’ve filled in “About you” and “Tax details” in their own account.
owners.shareNeedsYourDetails: You can have a share once you’ve filled in <profile>About you</profile> and <tax>Tax details</tax>.
owners.handoverLead: You can hand the primary role to a co-owner. They must accept it, and need their details, tax and payouts in place and room for one more listing in their account. You stay on as a co-owner with your share, but only the primary owner can remove owners, set the shares, open the deeds and delete the listing.
owners.handoverOfferQuestion: Offer the primary role to <person>{name}</person>? Nothing changes until they accept, and you can take the offer back until then.
owners.handoverPending: <person>{name}</person> has been offered the primary role. The offer lapses on <time>{date}</time>.
owners.handoverPendingYou: You’ve been offered the primary role. The offer lapses on <time>{date}</time>.
owners.handoverAcceptQuestion: Take over the primary role? You’ll be able to remove owners, set the shares, open the deeds and delete the listing, and you’ll get its status emails. The current primary owner stays on as a co-owner with their share.
owners.handoverWithdrawQuestion: Take back the offer of the primary role?
owners.handoverDeclineQuestion: Decline the offer of the primary role? The primary owner stays as they are.
owners.handoverClosed: The offer of the primary role is closed.
owners.handoverStale: That offer is no longer open, so this page now shows how things stand.
owners.keepOffer: No, leave it as it is
owners.managersLead: Managers look after the listing day to day: they see the calendar and the bookings, cancel bookings, and set closures and special hours. They have no share, see no earnings, and can’t edit the listing or invite anyone. Only the primary owner adds or removes them.
owners.removeManagerQuestion: Remove <person>{name}</person> as a manager? They won’t see this listing’s calendar or bookings any more.
owners.inviteTitlePrimary: Invite an owner or a manager
owners.inviteRoleCoOwnerText: Has full control of the listing and is paid a share once you set one. Starts at 0%.
owners.inviteRoleManagerText: Looks after the listing day to day. No share, no earnings, and can’t edit the listing.
owners.roomManagers: {count, plural, =0 {This listing already has the most managers and invitations to manage allowed ({max}).} one {You can add # more manager or invitation to manage.} other {You can add # more managers or invitations to manage.}}
owners.inviteLeadOwner: We’ll email a link that works for {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}. It is accepted by signing in, or creating an account, with that address, and the new owner starts at 0% until the primary owner gives them a share.

invite.title: Invitation to a listing
invite.missing: This page needs the link from the invitation email. Open it from the email again.
invite.notFound: This invitation link doesn’t work. Ask whoever invited you for a new one.
invite.expired: This invitation has expired. Ask whoever invited you for a new one.
invite.used: This invitation has already been accepted or withdrawn.
invite.meaning: You’ll have full control of the listing together with its other owners. The primary owner decides each owner’s share of the payouts.
invite.notForYou: This invitation was sent to another email address. Sign in with that address to accept it.
invite.accepted: You’re now one of this listing’s owners.
invite.signedOut: Sign in, or create an account, with the email address the invitation was sent to. Once you’re signed in, you’ll come back here to accept it.
invite.leadUnnamed: <person>{inviter}</person> invites you to co-own a parking listing.
invite.leadNoInviterUnnamed: You’re invited to co-own a parking listing.
invite.switchAccount: Sign out, then sign in with the invited address
invite.signOutFailed: We couldn’t sign you out. Try again.

manager.leadUnnamed: <person>{inviter}</person> invites you to manage a parking listing.
manager.leadNoInviterUnnamed: You’re invited to manage a parking listing.
manager.meaning: You’ll see the listing’s calendar and bookings, be able to cancel bookings, and set closures and special hours. You won’t have a share or see earnings, and you can’t edit the listing.

managed.title: Listings you manage
managed.lead: You look after these day to day. The primary owner adds and removes managers; you can’t edit a listing or see its earnings.

BookSpace.holdHint: We keep the space for you for {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}} while you book.
BookSpace.noneLeft: Someone else has just booked the last free space for those times. Choose other times.

BookingErrors.generic: Something went wrong. Check your connection and try again.
BookingErrors.BOOKING_UNAVAILABLE: This parking can’t be booked online yet.
BookingErrors.LISTING_NOT_FOUND: This parking can no longer be booked.
BookingErrors.SPACE_NOT_FOUND: That space can no longer be booked. Choose another one.
BookingErrors.SPACE_TAKEN: Someone else has just booked this space for those times. Choose another space.
BookingErrors.LISTING_CLOSED: This parking can’t be booked for your stay any more. Choose other times or another place.
BookingErrors.OWN_LISTING: This is your own parking, so you can’t book it.
BookingErrors.BOOKING_NOT_ACTIVE: This hold has ended. Choose the space again to book it.
BookingErrors.BOOKING_STARTED: This stay has already begun, so it can’t be cancelled here.
BookingErrors.REFUND_CHANGED: The refund has changed, because your arrival is nearer now. Check it and cancel again.
BookingErrors.HOLD_LIMIT_REACHED: This space can’t be kept any longer. Book it now, or let it go.
BookingErrors.PAYMENT_PROVIDER_ERROR: Payments aren’t available right now. Try again in a moment.

Booking.heldUntil: We’re keeping space <space>{space}</space> for you until {time} (Greek time). {checkout, select, payment {Pay} other {Confirm}} by then; if you need longer, keep it for another {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}.
Booking.plateHint: The car’s registration, for example IKB-1234. The owner sees it, so they know your car.
Booking.noPayment: This test site takes no payment: the booking is confirmed without one.
Booking.confirmedLead: We’ve emailed you the details. Show the booking reference if you’re asked.
Booking.cancelQuestion: Cancel this booking? You’ll get {refund} back.
Booking.cancelQuestionNoRefund: Cancel this booking? Under the cancellation terms, nothing comes back to you.
Booking.cancelledByDriver: You cancelled this booking. {refund} comes back to you.
Booking.cancelledByOwner: The owner had to cancel this booking. You get the full {refund} back.
Booking.started: This stay has begun, so it can’t be cancelled here.
Booking.releasedLead: You let this space go, so it isn’t kept for you any more.
Booking.unavailable: Your booking can’t be shown right now. Please try again in a moment.
Booking.heldEnded: The space may be someone else’s now. Choose it again to book it.
Booking.cancelledByDriverNoRefund: You cancelled this booking. Under the cancellation terms, nothing comes back to you.
Booking.refundChanged: Less comes back now that your arrival is nearer: {refund}. Press “Yes, cancel it” again to cancel anyway.
Booking.keep: Keep it for {minutes, plural, one {# more minute} other {# more minutes}}
Booking.holdWarning: Your hold on this space ends at {time} (Greek time). Need more time? Keep it for longer below.
Booking.holdLimit: This space has been kept as long as it can be. {checkout, select, payment {Pay} other {Confirm}} before {time} (Greek time), or let it go.
Booking.releaseQuestion: Let space <space>{space}</space> go? Someone else can book it straight away.
Booking.paymentLead: You pay {amount} now. Your booking is confirmed as soon as the payment goes through.
Booking.paymentFailed: The payment didn’t go through. Try again, or use another card.
Booking.paymentUnavailable: Payments aren’t available right now. Nothing was charged; try again in a moment.
Booking.paymentProcessingLead: Your bank is still confirming it. We’ll email you once it’s settled: your booking, or all your money back if the space was taken meanwhile.
Booking.paymentRefundedLead: We couldn’t book the space with this payment, so all of it goes back to you. It can take a few days to show on your card or bank statement.
Booking.paymentUncertain: We couldn’t tell whether your payment went through. Don’t pay again yet: check this booking in a moment.
Booking.paymentLoadFailed: The payment form couldn’t load. Check your connection, or turn off anything that blocks scripts, then try again.
Booking.paymentChecksStopped: We’ve stopped checking on this page. Use Check again, or wait for our email.
Booking.paymentUnpaidLead: Nothing was charged. You can pay again below, with the same card or another.
Booking.paymentCanceled: Nothing was charged: the payment was called off once your hold had ended.
Booking.refundToCard: It goes back to the card you paid with and can take a few days to show on your card or bank statement.
